answer_text: OAP section 8 locates housing programmes for families and students principally to the west of the Joliot-Curie quartier (c-01)[les programmes de logements familiaux et étudiants sont implantés principalement à l'Ouest du quartier]. The habitat core is described as lying between the Nord-Sud structuring axis, the rue Joliot-Curie and the Ferme du Moulon (c-03)[La polarité quartier d'habitat-cœur campus Joliot-Curie se localise entre l'axe structurant Nord-Sud, la rue Joliot-Curie, axe Est-Ouest, et la Ferme du Moulon]. The schematic plan on the same page shows the orange habitat-dominant band on the western side of the perimeter (c-02)[orange hatched band, west of the central blue-hatched campus areas].
additional_context: The quoted text is on printed page 35 (PDF page 36). The OAP does not give a distance or boundary for the western zone, so this answer does not assess whether the parcel lies within it. That geometric check is outside this question.

citations.claim: The OAP states that housing programmes for families and students are implanted principally to the west of the quartier.
citations.verification_instructions: TEXT | oap_91272_20210706 | page=36 (printed page 35) | quote='les programmes de logements familiaux et étudiants sont implantés principalement à l'Ouest du quartier pour favoriser la mixité'
citations.reasoning: Read oap_91272_20210706 page 36 (printed p. 35) as text. The third bullet under 'Les liens fonctionnels entre les programmes et leur localisation dans le quartier' reads: 'les programmes de logements familiaux et étudiants sont implantés principalement à l'Ouest du quartier pour favoriser la mixité en privilégiant la proximité des services et des équipements publics.' This matches the claim that family and student housing is sited principally to the west of the quartier.

citations.claim: The habitat core of the quartier lies between the Nord-Sud structuring axis, the rue Joliot-Curie (east-west axis) and the Ferme du Moulon.

citations.reasoning: Read the same page text. The paragraph beginning 'La polarité quartier d'habitat-cœur campus Joliot-Curie' states it 'se localise entre l'axe structurant Nord-Sud, la rue Joliot-Curie, axe Est-Ouest, et la Ferme du Moulon.' This matches the claim in substance.
